results.title: Incident response
results.text:
## First hour

1. Acknowledge the page in the primary channel.
2. Open a journal note and paste the customer impact in one sentence.
3. If checkout is involved, read the [[checkout-rewrite]] status before changing a flag.

Escalate SEV-1 using [[paging]]. Ship the fix only inside the [[deploy-window]].

## Freeze exceptions

A SEV-1 may ship outside the deploy window. The incident lead records that exception in the journal. Routine checkout changes wait for the next window.

wiki/concepts/paging.md.title: Paging
wiki/concepts/paging.md.content:
# Paging

A page is a phone alert. Chat messages are not pages.
## Severity

- SEV-1 pages immediately: checkout down, or payment auth failing for every customer.
- SEV-2 waits for a person already awake, and pages during the deploy window only.

The [[incident-response]] SOP owns the first hour after a page.

# Acme Payments

Acme Payments authorizes card charges for Northline checkout. It is the only card vendor in production.
## Contract

The current contract renews in March. A vendor freeze blocks new Acme endpoints until that renewal. See [[adr-014-vendor-freeze]].

wiki/projects/checkout-rewrite.md.title: Checkout rewrite
wiki/projects/checkout-rewrite.md.content:
# Checkout rewrite

Replace the legacy checkout service with a single order API. Stored cards are out of scope until the payment vendor allows a new endpoint.
## Status

Blocked on the [[adr-014-vendor-freeze|vendor freeze]] for Acme Payments. The November checkout outage is written up in [[2026-11-12-checkout-outage]].
